exposure: ART use for more than two years
outcome: early initiation of breastfeeding (within one hour of birth)
continued breastfeeding to one year of age
cohort: 524 HIV-positive mother-child pairs enrolled in the PMTCT program across Kilimanjaro, Tanzania, with children under two years of age.
finding: Adherence to breastfeeding recommendations for HIV-positive women is suboptimal, particularly for continued breastfeeding for one year.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was a significant risk factor for not achieving early initiation of breastfeeding.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (specific values not provided)
